annotations.title: Spiegel mit & ohne Rahmen finden Sie bei Höffner online

content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog** — the U.S. mail-order retailer known for home shopping — it does **not appear to have an active official “Spiegel Home” online catalog/shop today**.

Spiegel was historically a catalog retailer selling apparel, home furnishings, housewares, and other goods. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai)) The current search results mostly show **German “Spiegel” pages for mirrors** — “Spiegel” means “mirror” in German — not the classic U.S. Spiegel catalog. Examples include home24, Höffner, Westwing, and similar mirror-shopping pages. ([hoeffner.de](https://www.hoeffner.de/garderoben-spiegel?utm_source=openai))

If you’re looking for similar online catalog-style home shopping, try retailers like:

- **Wayfair**
- **L.L.Bean Home**
- **Pottery Barn**
- **Frontgate**
- **Ballard Designs**
- **The Company Store**
- **Amazon Home**
- **Walmart Home**
- **Target Home**

If you meant **buying mirrors online** — because “Spiegel” = mirror — then the German results like home24, Höffner, Westwing, and Nielsen Design Shop are relevant.
